name: GOV aave-fork: PoolConfiguratorUpdated
description: Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider (and forks on Monad): PoolConfiguratorUpdated(address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
